vulnerability_summary: DecodeStream allowed unbounded decompression until the fix introduced a 100 MB cap.
causality: Fix 8c3b6a713b3de767e1bdcc37ce831ecbce0212f3 added the decompression limit. Devin migration commits 430f68266653c0f54ca9bbb30f6982c9373855f5 and e4a4c300cd20dc34166e25565908d0a9afdb58f5 copied DecodeStream into the monorepo without changing blob 7143ab4c5317ef1446911165c732ffd189c34268. The same vulnerable implementation already existed in human commit 31c54cd543f675f6e0d5159c43f0623de84f716a and the mainline already depended on the affected pdf-lib package before the migration.
